text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, Sweep! It's your birthday today, 
right? I've got the absolute best present 
ready for ya!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, the best? Obviously *my* present is 
going to be the most amazing of all! 
...Right, Sweep—

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text:
Just for today, I'll be your disciple! 
Just for today, I'll be your apprentice!

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text:
Hey, whoa! Stop copying me! Wait, hey! 
Don't copy that too!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: ...Hmm, this might just be a perfect fit.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
You guys, lend me a hand with my magic! 
It's a grand spell chanted in unison by 
the three of us!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
You two should be able to do it! I mean, 
when you get down to it, aren't you cut 
from the same cloth?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Haaah!? As if! There's no way magic like 
that is possible!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Huh? ...Just so you know, this is Master's 
order, okay?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
It's my birthday present, isn't it?! Then 
just obediently do what I say!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Or was the present just a lie?! I will 
ab-so-lute-ly NEVER forgive you for that!!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"...Gaaaah! Fine, I get it! I already 
promised to be your disciple anyway!"

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Kh...! I'm not one to take back my words 
either! Let's do this!
